name: Population-based AF Analysis (New Dataset - Comparable)
description: Population-based AF patients with 1-year stroke prediction outcome to match original dataset analysis. Includes patients with definitive 1-year outcomes: stroke_1Y=1 (stroke within 1Y) vs stroke_1Y=2 (no stroke within 1Y).

metadata.use_case: Apples-to-apples comparison with original dataset for 1-year stroke risk prediction
metadata.notes: This configuration creates a comparable population to the original dataset by focusing on 1-year stroke prediction. Includes only patients with definitive 1-year outcomes: stroke_1Y=1 (stroke within 1Y) vs stroke_1Y=2 (no stroke within 1Y). Excludes stroke_1Y=3 (stroke after 1Y) and stroke_1Y=4 (pre-AF strokes) for clean comparison.
